description: Derive a dark counterpart from light-mode tokens. Pass `tokens` as `name: colour` lines (CSS custom properties work), a JSON object of name to colour, or an array of {name, color}. Roles are guessed from the name (surface, raised surface, text, border, accent, on-accent) and then from the colour. Surfaces are rebuilt around OKLCH L 0.19 with raised layers stepped lighter; text is mapped to light values under pure white; borders keep their distance from the surface; accents keep hue, gain lightness and lose about 15 percent chroma. Text and accents are nudged until they reach 4.5:1 on the lightest dark surface. Returns the mapping per token with a note, any pairs that still fail with their ratios, and CSS variables. The lifted-surface approach is a convention, not a standard.

tokens.description: Light tokens: "bg: #fff\ntext: #111\nprimary: #2563eb", a JSON object, or an array of {name, color}.
